title: Sixty-Seven Garments in a Rented Flat: How Goonj Began
conflicts: Founding year: Gupta himself (InsideIIM; INK) says he quit and founded Goonj in 1998, while the Magsaysay Foundation, Goonj, his website, the Indian Express, Reader's Digest and Gulf News say 1999; the story gives both. Scale: over 1,000 tonnes a year (Gulf News, Indian Express 2015), more than a million kg a year (Magsaysay 2015), 'around 4,000 tons so far' (Reader's Digest 2019), over 3,500 tonnes a year (Wikipedia). Tonnage left out; story uses only 21 states and three million pads from the 2015 citation. Habib's daughter's words have three different wordings, so they are paraphrased. Flat: 'two-bedroom rented' (Gulf News) vs 'their own home' (Reader's Digest).
notes: Meenakshi Gupta named as co-founder in the founder field. Business Standard interviews refused my requests and are not cited. Quote stance: affirms.
